description: Get a live, read-only swap quote on ICPSwap (the deepest on-chain DEX on ICP): how much receive_token you would get for pay_amount of pay_token. No tokens move — this prices the intent; execution happens in the agent's own wallet/canister. Tokens can be symbols (ICP, ckUSDC, ckUSDT, ckBTC, ckETH) or ledger principals.

fee.description: Optional pool fee tier in hundredths of a bps (3000 = 0.3%). Defaults to trying 3000, then 10000, then 500.

pay_amount.description: Amount to sell, in base units as a decimal string (e.g. "100000000" = 1 ICP).

pay_token.description: Token to sell: symbol or ledger principal.

receive_token.description: Token to buy: symbol or ledger principal.

name: get_swap_quote
